title: Learning Unknown Oscillators From Bandit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.27492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study semi-bandits driven by unknown oscillators. Each round, a learner selects two of four reward channels and observes their individual rewards. Frequency errors change future reward rankings and the resulting measurements. We show when committing to one fitted oscillator lets its greedy choices expose prediction errors. Our controller bounds reward loss (regret) over a continuous confidence set and holds the longest block within budget. An online regression policy gathers observations when the check fails. Regret grows at a square-root rate, up to logarithmic factors, across all frequencies and extends to two competing oscillators. On 96 fresh synthetic instances, checked commitment uses 49 fits instead of 1,023, with 1.5% higher mean regret than fitting every round. Matched isolated timings give a 4.69-fold speedup. The confidence sets also certify trajectory regret.

translated_title: 从老虎机反馈中学习未知振荡器
translated_abstract: 我们研究由未知振荡器驱动的半老虎机问题。每一轮，学习者从四个奖励通道中选择两个并观察各自的奖励。频率误差会改变未来的奖励排序以及由此产生的测量结果。我们展示了何时承诺于一个已拟合的振荡器，可以让其贪心选择暴露预测误差。我们的控制器在连续置信集上界定奖励损失（后悔值），并在预算内保持最长的时间块。当检验失败时，在线回归策略会收集观测数据。在所有频率下，后悔值以平方根速率增长（最多相差对数因子），并且该方法可扩展到两个相互竞争的振荡器。在96个新的合成实例上，带检验的承诺方法仅使用49次拟合而非1023次，平均后悔值仅比每轮拟合高1.5%。在匹配的独立计时下实现了4.69倍的加速。该置信集还能保证轨迹后悔值。
tldr: 提出了一种带检验的承诺控制器，在未知振荡器驱动的半老虎机问题上实现了平方根级后悔界，并将拟合次数从1023次降至49次，带来4.69倍的加速。
en_tdlr: A checked-commitment controller for semi-bandits driven by unknown oscillators achieves square-root regret bounds while reducing the number of fits from 1,023 to 49, yielding a 4.69-fold speedup.
